svg.title: Anatomy of a decoder block: masked self-attention, cross-attention, and feed-forward
svg.desc: Shows how target tokens flow through three sub-layers in a decoder block, with the encoder output feeding cross-attention K and V, and a causal mask blocking future positions in self-attention.
svg.text: Decoder block — three sub-layers, two cross-stack inputs

g.text: Q, K, V all from x · tgt_mask
Q from decoder · K, V from enc_out

svg.text: output → next decoder layer (or final projection)

g.text: • Three sub-layers instead of two (extra cross-attention in the middle)
• Self-attention uses causal mask (no future peeking) — encoder uses padding only
• Receives encoder output as external K, V — encoder is self-contained
